sentences.en: Knead the dough with both hands until it becomes elastic.
sentences.zh: 用手揉面团直到它变得有弹性。

sentences.en: Filo pastry is very elastic and has a low fat content.
sentences.zh: 菲洛酥皮非常有弹性，脂肪含量也很低。

sentences.en: A rubber ball bounces because it is elastic.
sentences.zh: 因为有弹性，橡胶球可以弹跳。

senses.zh: 橡皮圈，有松紧的东西，松紧带
有弹性的，灵活的，可变的
